authorization: Root approved narrow edits only to website/app.js and website/styles.css after three read-only UI findings; root owns index/content/data updates.
changes: Restore exact known backend from query or direct panel hash; direct hash wins and canonicalizes query via replaceState.
User clicks push shareable URL state; Arrow/Home/End replace current entry and prevent-scroll focus. Ordinary section anchors and repository subpath remain intact.
Initial restore never moves focus; history/hash restore only relocates focus from tablist or a newly hidden panel.
Inline prose links retain underlines. Selected tab uses accent border plus 3px inset underline with measured 9.42:1 contrast against selected fill.

minimal_dom.scope: Actual app.js executed in minimal DOM/history fixture; not browser, rendering, assistive-technology, or actual scrolling verification

browser.pending: Root will perform actual CUA/browser focus, visual, scrolling, NoJS and narrow-width checks.

unchanged_scope: No index.html, README, validation count, Rust source, QEMU script, Cargo, build, commit or push operation by this subtask.
Prior negative baseline state-review.json and initial audit report remain unchanged.
limitations: Minimal DOM execution verifies application state transitions and explicit focus calls; it cannot prove browser scrolling, actual focus rendering, screen-reader behavior, layout, or computed CSS.
History URL state is static presentation state only.
